about: Vendor specs the REST generator's tests read. Each .gz holds the exact bytes its commit-pinned URL served (gzip -9n); sha256 and bytes are of those decompressed bytes. Fetched 2026-10-21 between 08:50Z and 10:50Z; re-verified against the URLs (sha256 and size of the bytes served) at 2026-10-21T10:50:03Z (Graph) and 2026-10-21T11:49:07Z (the other four). The tests never fetch anything. Each licence file is the repository's licence at the same commit. A secret-shape scan (the catalog loader's rules) of every decompressed file found nothing.

specs.note: Google's Gmail API Discovery document as mirrored in Google's Go client at that commit. The live discovery service (https://gmail.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v1) returns the same document with its keys in a different order on each fetch, so its raw bytes cannot be pinned reproducibly; the mirror's can.

Microsoft Graph v1.0, the full description (17,885 operations), with the /me/... paths Outlook and Teams tools use; the per-module files Microsoft also publishes carry /users/{user-id}/... paths only. Its operation summaries are not reliable (GET /me/messages says 'Get open extension'), so every tool's description comes from the overlay.
The variant without examples: the variant with examples holds token-shaped sample values the secret scan refuses.
